Class HistoryManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.HistoryManager
public class HistoryManager extends Object

History Manager

Provides statistical analytics, empirical validation harnesses, and parameter calibration kernels.
Manages full-world state replay snapshots with direct-to-disk streaming, bounded LRU in-memory caching, on-the-fly fast-forward/rewind restoration, and explicit purge capabilities to eliminate OutOfMemory heap saturation during multi-millennial simulations.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getWorldSnapshot

      public List<H3Cell> getWorldSnapshot(long tickIndex)
      Restores a world snapshot for the given tick: - Returns immediately if present in the LRU RAM cache. - Decompresses and loads on-the-fly from disk if evicted from RAM.
      Parameters:
      tickIndex - the tick index
      Returns:
      the list of H3Cells representing world state, or null if not found

    • getWorldSnapshots

      public NavigableMap<Long, List<H3Cell>> getWorldSnapshots()
      Gets the virtual NavigableMap of all snapshots across the timeline. Keys and entries are loaded on-the-fly without holding all snapshots in heap memory simultaneously.
      Returns:
      NavigableMap facade
